measurementMethod: Re-read exported float32 positions and indices, reverse glTF axes into physical coordinates; projected foil area is half the sum of absolute XZ triangle projections of each closed part. Hull/equipment LOA excludes aft appendage extension; full mesh envelope is also reported. Draft is below waterline, before scene z+0.02 transform.

vessels.name: Jeanneau Sun Odyssey 24.2

Single tiller, sails furled, no deployed sprayhood.

vessels.name: Contessa 26

The distinct keel-hung rudder keeps the validated vertical equivalent axis.

Twin fixed rudders extend abaft the12.19m hull; full appendage envelope is measured separately.
